messages.text: Honestly? At month 6, picked up a second job part-time [E-A-001]. Most of what I'm learning is training others [ev_A_004]. My role these days: senior CNA [ev_A_004]. That's the part of this life I think about most.

I see it differently. At month 5, passed the first semester [E-B-001]. Most of what I'm learning is licensed nursing practice [ev_B_005]. My role these days: newly licensed registered nurse [ev_B_005]. That's the part of this life I think about most.
Fair, but from where I'm standing: What worries me most: hard physical work with a low pay ceiling [ev_A_008]. Stress? high [ev_A_007]. That's the part of this life I think about most.
